text_block_list.text:
During training with Biwa Hayahide.
As I timed her laps—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "...Didn't beat my time, huh? In fact, it was worse than last time..."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Kh... Not like this——!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Forgive me, I need to step away for a moment.
I'll be right back."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? Taishin, you're going home already!?
Stay and cheer with me a bit longer!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...No thanks. I've already done enough scouting.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Hello, you two.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah!!!! Hayahide!!!!
Look, right now I'm with Taishin—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you were watching, weren't you?
My run just now... that's why you came.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—Please. I beg of you, don't leave just yet.
Could you at least watch for just one more lap?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Heeh. Why's that?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It's because you all were watching that run earlier.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, my running lacks sharpness today.
However..."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"I don't want you thinking,
'Is this all my rivals amount to?!'"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I won't ever show you such a spineless run again.
I—your rival—
will become even stronger! So...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: *Sigh*... Just one more lap, okay?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah!! Do you have your ticket ready?
You should definitely come again—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
UWWWWAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHN!!!!
OF COURZE I WILLLLL~~!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Why are you crying!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
B-B-B-But waaaah!!
Having rivals is just so great, y'knooow?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Heh, that is...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I agree.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—Now, Trainer.
Could you time me once more?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I will become even stronger.
I can't go breaking my promise to them...!!

And Biwa Hayahide recorded
her best time of the month.

—Without a doubt, from this day forward,
the sharpness of her running increased dramatically.
